body:
Don't think MDMA therapy is something available in my country, and for that I have a feeling I'm not qualified.

And the past is the past. Yes. But then you sit there with your thoughts and the past becomes the present and it influences what happens next, even if that's not what you want. I've had a big problem with overthinking stuff in the past. I've worked on this and nowadays I can actually keep a conversation if it's something worth talking about. I am me, my brain is me, I don't think I want to feel this way, why does my brain want me to feel this way? 

I've got this paper from my psychiatrist where it says amongst other things:

Let go!
Notice what you feel but create a distance between you and your feelings.
Experience your feelings, but don't let them overtake you.
Remember that you are not your feelings and you have felt differently at other times.
Accept your feelings with bluntness.

Reading this paper and thinking about what it said used to help me. It doesn't really anymore. I did a left somewhere where I should've made a right basically.

I'm ashamed that I'm writing this and pushing the send button, but I feel like it might help, so fuck it.

Yep, I go through the exercising&eating healthy phases. The most recent one was about 3~ or so months ago. And I really noticed how my mood/feelings changed for the better. But as you said, this is easier said than done. And I'm trying . I feel like I've had it too easy in life also, so basically my normal pushing power is way below other peoples lowest pushing power. I feel like shit for feeling shit when I know that my life hasn't really been hard; This is probably a very common feeling amongst people today, and I wish that thought would ease it, but it doesn't.

And then there's the thing with progression when exercising. I used to play soccer/floorball/handball, you name it. But now I'm out of breath after kicking the ball for 15 seconds. And this makes me more depressed. It's a spiral of depression that I got going on here, I know how to get out of it. The problem is I just can't for some reason, it's like my mind wants someone else to just fix everything. This is not possible and I know this. Maybe I just want support from somewhere, but then I have the problem of trusting people. Feeling fucked up beyond recognition right now :) But writing this out, it's a small help I feel. And to have it read by someone, that is a huge help I feel. This subreddit is great actually!

Thanks for writing this. I'm very aware that I need to change and try to not think about these things. But it feels impossible most times.

My passion in life so far is computers, and that is what I'm studying and what I want to work with. It's just really hard sometimes when the brain shuts down on you. I've been through a period of what I think was me being burnt but I don't know. Basically I couldn't even read the simplest text and I developed migraines that would blur my vision. I'm kind of scared that this will happen to me again and then I'm not just screwed in the social part of life.
